title: The LORD Looks at the Heart

request.style: English, classic country, warm baritone male vocal with twang, acoustic guitar, pedal steel, fiddle, upright bass, brushed snare, storytelling ballad, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Out on the hills by Bethlehem a ruddy shepherd boy
Kept his father's flock by night and sang his songs of joy
Seven brothers passed the prophet, tall and fine to see
But the LORD looks at the heart, and the youngest one was he

[Verse]
Down in the Valley of Elah a giant cursed and roared
The soldiers stood there trembling, every hand upon a sword
A boy ran out with just a sling, a stone and nothing more
And the giant fell before him, for the battle belongs to the LORD

[Chorus]
Shepherd boy and giant-slayer, harp-player and king
A heart that ran to God in every song he'd sing
He fell and he got up again, he wept and he believed
The LORD looks at the heart, and a broken heart's received

[Verse]
Up on a palace rooftop in the evening's fading light
A king took what was not his and hid it out of sight
Then Nathan stood before him and said, You are the man
And David fell before the LORD and wept with empty hands

[Bridge]
Have mercy on me, O God
Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow
Create in me a clean heart, O God
Renew a steadfast spirit within me

[Chorus]
Shepherd boy and giant-slayer, harp-player and king
A heart that ran to God in every song he'd sing
He fell and he got up again, he wept and he believed
The LORD looks at the heart, and a broken heart's received

[Outro]
The LORD looks at the heart
